note: Grants Bdo has issued that outlive one task. A standing grant is not a wider authority than a task grant; it is the same typed, scoped, budgeted, expiring grant, decided once instead of asked for each time. Every grant here is graded against contracts/authority-grant.schema.json and exercised only through scripts/sovkernel/authority.py. A grant at PROPOSED standing is inert: the evaluator refuses it, so writing a grant is never the same act as switching it on.

issue_rules.judgement_authority_note: JUDGEMENT authority may be issued by the owner alone. A grant claiming it from any other issuer is refused, which is what stops a participant minting its own right to ratify.
issue_rules.ratification_note: A grant moves PROPOSED -> RATIFIED only by Bdo's recorded acceptance of its decision record. Nothing in the loop may perform that edit for him. grant:standing-landing-loop was ratified on 2026-08-25 and its verification cadence was amended by Bdo on 2026-08-28 in decisions/0098: ordinary BUILT landing requires the expected Blue checks, while independent witness is queued at named milestones and remains mandatory for transitions that consume WITNESSED evidence.

grants.note: The standing authorization decided with Bdo on 2026-08-25 and amended on 2026-08-28 by decisions/0098-milestone-witnessing.md. It lets a self-tested, in-scope BUILT change reach main without a fresh conversation or per-increment witness, and it reaches no further. The grant excludes its own registry and schema, so an exercise cannot widen itself. The VERIFICATION type still cannot ratify a JUDGEMENT claim. Independent observation remains a separate requirement wherever the next transition consumes it: BUILT -> WITNESSED, milestone acceptance/release gates that name it, and CAPABLE_NODE admission. Landing ordinary BUILT work is therefore not evidence of WITNESSED standing. The budget is per exercise, not cumulative. docs/ remains inside scope because documentation.html is a generated projection that can go stale when repository text changes.
